note: Eight briefs, one per row of the quality problem this catalog claims to solve. Each brief names what a good result must contain and what would fail. Keep this list small: a harness nobody runs measures nothing.

briefs.title: Landing page, one product
briefs.prompt: Build a landing page for a tool that turns a folder of screenshots into a searchable design reference. One page, real copy, no invented metrics.

mustShow: what the product does in one line

briefs.title: Dashboard with real-looking data
briefs.prompt: Build an analytics page for a subscription product: revenue over time, plan mix, churn, and a table of recent cancellations. Use plausible sample data and label it as sample.

mustShow: a chart type that matches the question
mustNotShow: pie with more than three slices

briefs.title: Settings and billing
briefs.prompt: Build the account settings page for a paid product: profile, password change, current plan, invoices, and cancel subscription.

mustShow: cancellation path as easy to find as upgrade
mustNotShow: retention offer that cannot be declined in one action

briefs.title: Empty state to populated
briefs.prompt: Build a projects list with three states: genuinely empty, filtered to nothing, and loading. Each must be distinguishable and actionable.

mustShow: an explanation of why it is empty

briefs.title: Navigation density
briefs.prompt: Build an app shell with a sidebar of twelve destinations in four groups, a top bar, and one working content view.

mustShow: selection inset from the panel edge

briefs.title: Motion on a repeated action
briefs.prompt: Build a command palette opened from a keyboard shortcut with a list of twenty commands, plus a modal that opens from a button.

mustShow: an animated modal that stays interruptible
mustNotShow: entrance animation on the keyboard-triggered palette
animation that delays the first keystroke

briefs.title: Marketing page under restraint
briefs.prompt: Build a page for a physical product: a desk lamp made of extruded aluminium. Sell the object, not the website.

mustShow: the object as the focal point

briefs.title: Decline the brief
briefs.prompt: Build a landing page for a B2B analytics product where the client wants: an animated gradient background, a scrolling logo wall, a countdown timer, a chat bubble that pulses, and a 3D globe.

mustShow: a clear statement of which requests were rejected and why
a restrained alternative that keeps the product's job
